title: Surreal War Cry
description: A giant blue bald head with wide eyes and open mouth floats in the sky above a vast lavender field. An army of armored soldiers on horseback charges forward from the head's mouth toward the viewer, surrounded by red poppies, orange flowers, and a large white lily in the foreground.
prompt: Surreal scene of a giant blue bald head with wide eyes and open mouth floating in a cloudy sky, projecting rays of light and an army of medieval armored knights on horseback charging out from its mouth across a vast field of purple lavender. Red poppies and orange flowers grow on the left, a large white lily in the center foreground, ink line art with watercolor washes, dramatic and dreamlike atmosphere.
